question: For temporary share links, what should a logged-out visitor see?
mermaid:
flowchart LR
  V[visitor with link] --> G{link scope}
  G -- whole site --> S[read-only site]
  G -- day-of only --> D[day-of planner]

options.label: Whole site, read-only
options.description: Every page renders; edit controls and dollar amounts are hidden.

options.label: Day-of planner only
options.description: The link opens the day-of planner and nothing else resolves.

options.label: Configurable per link
options.description: The link carries its own scope; the share dialog picks it.
options.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  L[link] --> C{scope on link}
  C --> A[site]
  C --> B[day-of]
